details.description: An axial column of cyan light rising from the apex aperture, brightest at its base and falling to zero alpha at the top. No surface, no shading gradient across its width.
details.affects: emissive colour and intensity of the beam volume

details.description: A glowing torus ring lying flush in the floor of the crown basin, concentric with the aperture. Constant emission, reads as a light source spilling onto the basin walls.
details.affects: emissive colour, intensity and a matching point light

details.description: A crisp bright line along the top outer edge of every crown collar plate: a real chamfer catching grazing key light, not a painted highlight.
A cyan strip inset into the outward face of each collar plate, running with the plate's lean. Soft-edged glow, no relief: a recessed emissive strip, not an engraved groove.
details.affects: emissive inlay strip repeated once per collar plate

details.description: Two stacked amber horizontal bars on the front pylon head, the only warm hue on the upper structure. Lower value than the cyan, constant.
details.affects: emissive amber colour and intensity on stacked bar geometry

details.description: A dark recessed square on the pylon head carrying three short amber dashes and one pale square. Flat against the surface, no thickness.
details.affects: canvas-texture decal region on the dark gloss panel

details.description: The silver cap plates on the lower pods and buttresses hold a tight bright highlight along their crowns while the surrounding steel stays broad and soft: a localized low-roughness zone.
details.affects: roughness 0.18 over the cap plates against 0.55 on the body steel

details.description: Each lower pod carries a dark inset screen on its outward face, set below the surrounding plate: a real recess with its own dark gloss interior, not a dark patch.
details.affects: socket recess, depth 0.03 object-relative, interior uses glass-dark

details.description: A vertical cyan-lit channel recessed into the lateral face of each lower pod, with AO darkening at the channel mouth.
details.affects: negative relief channel, width 0.02 depth 0.02, emissive floor

details.description: The plinth's top rim is a wide chamfer, wider than any other bevel on the model, reading as a bright band all the way round the hexagon.
A round amber-lit boss at each plinth corner, one per hexagon vertex: a radially distributed instanced system with a hemispherical head, raised rather than countersunk.
details.affects: InstancedMesh, count 6, radial distribution, hemisphere head, emissive amber

details.description: The front entry ramp carries cyan strips across its treads, stepping down toward the viewer.
details.affects: emissive cyan strips repeated per tread

details.description: Loose grey gravel scattered on the plinth top in front of the structure, breaking the otherwise clean silhouette of the tier joint. Changes the silhouette, so geometry rather than a texture patch.
details.affects: instanced low-poly rock scatter, seeded, 18 pieces

details.description: Each tier meets the one below in a soft dark line rather than a hard groove: an AO seam, no measurable depth at this resolution.
details.affects: AO darkening along tier joints, no geometric relief
